"Duel Quests":
"Duel Quests are difficult Solo Quests in which your objective is to defeat a powered-up boss enemy.

There are two types of Duel Quests: Standard Duels, and Extra Duels.

※Duel Quests can be accepted from the Quest Counter."

"Before challenging a Standard Duel, it is recommended that you enhance your equipment with Duel Quest-specific \"Defi\" Special Abilities, such as Defi Eris P.01.

\"Defi\" Special Abilities apply their effects only within their designated Standard Duels, and only when equipping a weapon that can be used by your Main Class."

"\"Defi\" Special Ability Capsules are mainly obtained through the following methods:

・Season Point Exchange Shops
・The Item Trader's Giga Stragment Exchange
・Limited Quest rewards"
